name: Sun Gardens Dubrovnik
positioning: Beachfront resort in the village of Orasac, 11 km from Dubrovnik city centre, with hotel rooms, residences and a villa
best_for: Families wanting a kids club and children's sports programmes
Travelers who want a beach and pool resort base outside Dubrovnik

facts.text: Sun Gardens Dubrovnik is a beachfront resort.
The resort is in the small village of Orasac, 11 km from Dubrovnik city centre.
Guests can choose a hotel room, a suite, a private residence or a villa.
The resort beach is a pebble beach.
The sports centre offers more than a dozen sports and activities.
The resort's dining includes traditional Dalmatian dishes as well as cuisines from other parts of the world.
A resort web app lets guests reserve experiences, book tables and order food and drinks online.
A shopping promenade sits in the heart of the resort.
Guests can follow suggested hiking, running or cycling routes.
The resort can arrange vehicle rentals, private tours and airport transfers.
The resort has free outdoor parking.

highlights.text: The resort has three swimming pools and a beach with a private VIP area.
The Children Sports Academy runs weekly football, tennis, squash, swimming and water-sports programmes for children aged 7 to 15.
The resort villa is a five-bedroom sea-view villa with a private pool.
Sun Gardens FESTA is a summer programme of themed dining and entertainment events and parties.
The Marco Polo Kids Club runs a day and evening schedule for children of any age.

considerations.text: The resort is outside the city, in the village of Orasac, 11 km from Dubrovnik city centre.
The beach is a pebble beach rather than sand.
WhataHotel notes it is a large resort property that may feel less intimate.
